name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Uzivatele (Users) tab
description:
## Why?

Small read-only tab, no form inputs. Good candidate to port early alongside a heavier tab because it carries almost no risk.

## What?

Port `sub/ServiceDetail/Users.tpl` to React as a read-only table, remove the external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partial. No inputs, no write actions: only the table and its action links.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Table renders the same columns, ordering and empty state as the legacy tab
- Action links point at the same URLs
- Tab visibility gate unchanged (edit mode only, `serviceType` is module or service)
- Every `data-testid` from `Users.tpl` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- `Users.tpl` deleted and its bridge entry removed
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green

## Resources

- Legacy: `admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/Users.tpl`
- `cms/packages/Miscellaneous/Helper/Partners.php`
